g.text: Field contacts switch +24.2 (-F22) to the input; the input sinks to 0V inside the module (module 0V terminal M to the 0V bus, /E-01). Discrete inputs 0...24 -> OpenPLC remote device PLANT -> %IX100.0...%IX103.0.

Fail-safe wiring: ESTOP_OK, PB_STOP_OK, the LSL low-level switches, RAIN_DRY and the motor-healthy contacts are closed when healthy, so a broken wire or loss of the remote I/O reads as the safe state (FDS §4.1).
Irrigation, fertigation and climate control, 1 000 m² greenhouse
OpenPLC Runtime v4 + Modbus TCP remote I/O
Electrical drawing set - control panel GH-1 (pump room)
